Certificate 4 in wall and floor Tiling

Physical stamina and strength.

Installing Tiles: Carefully placing tiles in rows or patterns, ensuring they are aligned and spaced correctly.
Grouting: Filling gaps between tiles with grout to provide a finished look and prevent moisture penetration.
Sealing: Applying sealants to protect tiled surfaces from stains, water damage, and wear.
Quality Inspection: Checking finished work for accuracy, uniformity, and adherence to design specifications.
Repair and Maintenance: Replacing damaged tiles, re-grouting, and performing routine maintenance to keep tiled surfaces in good condition.
